title: AVALONBENCH: Evaluating LLMs Playing the Game of Avalon
reasoning: The paper describes a social deduction game where players have 'good' and 'evil' roles. However, these terms refer to game factions and objectives (succeeding/failing missions, assassinating Merlin) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of the LLMs' moral, ethical, or religious adherence in a real-world sense. The game involves deception and strategic play, not an ethical assessment of the LLM's outputs or behavior in a broader moral context. 'Good faith' is mentioned as a rhetoric technique within the game, not a moral evaluation of the LLM itself.
